info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Retail Orders Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Retail Order Cancellation API allows businesses to efficiently manage the cancellation of retail orders in bulk. This API provides a streamlined method to delete selected orders marked for cancellation, ensuring that inventory and resources are updated accordingly. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and retail management systems seeking to enhance order processing workflows. By utilizing this API, organizations can improve operational efficiency and reduce customer service overhead related to cancellations.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing order by providing the necessary order identifiers. Ensure that the order can be canceled based on its current state.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an order. It should contain all necessary information to identify the order that is to be canceled.

204.description: The order was successfully canceled with no content returned.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling an order operation.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_204.title: Order Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the order.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the order after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the cancellation.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_204.description: A response schema representing the result of an order cancellation operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information about the audit trail related to the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This header provides insight into the performance of the operation.
